'''TK-529''', also known as "'''Grimes'''" among its comrades, was a [[stormtrooper]] stationed on [[Hockaleg]] with a garrison during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His job was to oversee the workers for the super weapon [[Tarkin (superweapon)|Tarkin]], which is under construction over the planet. During his service, he heard of Darth Vader's presence on the space station and reported to his comrade [[TK-813]], who in turn relayed it to veteran [[Contrail/Legends|CT-4981]]. As the station exploded due to a rebel alliance [[Infiltration of the Tarkin|sabotage]], the workers on the planet turned on the Imperial occupation forces and killed all the soldiers in the garrison, including TK-529.
